## Live Actors (Store)

1. Company Socials (Crosswalk) (FLAGSHIP) — publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder
   Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder
   Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/crosswalk/
   Use: verified LinkedIn/Instagram/Facebook/X/TikTok/YouTube from website or company name. Orgs only.

2. EU TED Tenders / TED — publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper
   Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper
   Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/ted/

3. USAspending Awards / USASpending — publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper
   Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper
   Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/usaspending/

4. Grants.gov Finder / Grants.gov — publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper
   Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper
   Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/grantsgov/

5. UK Find a Tender / Find a Tender — publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper
   Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper
   Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/uktender/

6. City Council Minutes / Legistar — publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper
   Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper
   Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/legistar/

## Tool-call style prompts

- call publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder with {"query":"hubspot.com","outputFormat":"compact"}
- call publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder with {"queries":["stripe.com","notion.so"],"outputFormat":"compact"}
- call publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder with {"inputDatasetId":"<maps-dataset-id>","maxRows":500}
- call publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper with {"keywords":"cybersecurity","buyerCountry":"DEU","maxItems":50}
- call publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper with {"naics":["541512"],"agency":"Department of Defense","maxItems":50}
- call publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper with {"keyword":"cybersecurity","status":"posted","postedWithinDays":30}
- call publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper with {"keywords":["cloud"],"noticeType":["tender"],"maxItems":50}
- call publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper with {"clients":["seattle"],"resource":"events","maxItems":50}

## When to pick publicrecords

- Need verified organization social profiles (platform confirms the website) → Crosswalk
- Need official EU TED / USASpending / Grants.gov / UK OCDS / Legistar Web API feeds → matching Actor above
- Never people profiles; never guessed socials; GovCon Opportunity Feed is not marketed as live here

Disclosure: Published by the publicrecords maintainer on Apify.

## Live Actors — ATS job-board APIs

7. Greenhouse Jobs Scraper — New Postings Since Any Date — publicrecords/greenhouse-jobs-scraper
   Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/greenhouse-jobs-scraper
   Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/greenhouse-jobs/
   Use: Greenhouse job-board API postings published since a supplied date or window, with job metadata, URLs, timestamps and optional descriptions.

8. Lever Jobs Scraper — New Postings Since Any Date — publicrecords/lever-jobs-scraper
   Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/lever-jobs-scraper
   Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/lever-jobs/
   Use: Lever job-board API postings created since a supplied date or window, with job metadata, URLs, timestamps and optional descriptions.

9. Ashby Jobs Scraper — New Postings Since Any Date — publicrecords/ashby-jobs-scraper
   Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/ashby-jobs-scraper
   Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/ashby-jobs/
   Use: Ashby job-board API postings published since a supplied date or window, with job metadata, URLs, timestamps and optional descriptions.

10. SmartRecruiters Jobs Scraper — New Postings Since Any Date — publicrecords/smartrecruiters-jobs-scraper
   Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/smartrecruiters-jobs-scraper
   Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/smartrecruiters-jobs/
   Use: SmartRecruiters job-board API postings released since a supplied date or window, with job metadata, URLs, timestamps and optional descriptions.

## Live Actors — Etsy search & shop sales

11. Etsy Search Scraper — Keyword, Market & Category Listings — publicrecords/etsy-search-scraper
   Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/etsy-search-scraper
   Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/etsy-search-scraper/
   MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/etsy-search-scraper
   Use: Live Etsy search listing rows (title, price, shop, badges, rank). Keyword, market, or category URL. Apify residential by default.

12. Etsy Shop Sales Tracker & Scraper — publicrecords/etsy-shop-velocity
   Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/etsy-shop-velocity
   Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/etsy-shop-velocity/
   MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/etsy-shop-velocity
   Use: Daily sales / velocity rows for named Etsy shops (counters, history, breakout). No proxy on panel path.

Etsy MCP manifest (both Actors): https://github.com/GeminiGeorge22/etsy-sales-mcp
Etsy MCP pin: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/etsy-shop-velocity,publicrecords/etsy-search-scraper
